title: The Sun Also Rises
author: Ernest Hemingway
summary: A circle of American and British expatriates drift from Paris cafes to the bull-running fiesta in Pamplona. The narrator is in love with a woman who will not settle with him, and the tension rises among the men around her.
readIf: you like spare, understated prose about people who drink to avoid saying what they mean.
skipIf: you want sympathetic characters; the period's casual antisemitism is also hard to read.

pairings.reason: Another short novel about a careless, glamorous generation and the emptiness underneath.
The same author's more emotional war novel with a more traditional love story.
A later, more exuberant story of friends moving from place to place looking for something real.
